item_meadbaseinvisibility_t1_description: Ferment to brew a faint veil mead.
item_meadbaseinvisibility_t2_description: Ferment to brew a deep veil mead.
item_meadbaseinvisibility_t3_description: Ferment to brew a shadow veil mead.
item_meadinvisibility_t1_description: Enemies notice you less. Attacking ends the veil and tires you.
item_meadinvisibility_t2_description: Enemies cannot see or hear you. Attacking reveals you for a while.
item_meadinvisibility_t3_description: Enemies cannot see or hear you. Attacking reveals you briefly.
ip_se_tooltip_t2: Enemies ignore you until you attack.
ip_se_tooltip_t3: Enemies ignore you until you attack.
ip_se_revealed_tooltip: Your veil was broken: you move slower and regenerate stamina, eitr and health slowly until the veil returns.
ip_se_cooldown_tooltip: No veil mead can be drunk until this runs out.
ip_msg_lower_tier: A stronger veil is already active
item_veilgoggles_t1_description: Crude resin lenses in bronze rims. Through them, Huldra's Hair shows on the bark of Black Forest firs and pines.
item_veilgoggles_t2_description: Pale crystal lenses in silver. They show Huldra's Hair and the hidden Baldr's Tear of the mountains.
item_veilgoggles_t3_description: Obsidian lenses in a flametal mask. They show every veiled plant, Hel's Ember Fern among them, and the wanderers hidden by the deepest veil.
item_veilingredient_t1_description: A tuft of pale lichen, tied with twine. It shivers when nobody looks.
item_veilingredient_t2_description: A pale blossom with a faintly glowing heart, cool to the touch.
item_veilingredient_t3_description: A black frond dusted with spores that still smoulder.
piece_ip_huldrasapling_description: Plant a tuft of Huldra's Hair on the trunk of a fir or pine. Only veil goggles show it growing.
ip_sapling_needs_tree: Needs a fir or pine trunk
ip_sapling_tree_taken: Huldra's Hair already grows on this tree
piece_ip_baldrsapling_description: Plant Baldr's Tear on cultivated ground in the Mountains. Only veil goggles (level II) show it growing.
piece_ip_fernsapling_description: Plant Hel's Ember Fern on cultivated ground in the Ashlands. Only veil goggles (level III) show it growing.
